title: Shivlal Jaiswal v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Writ disposed; recovery citation withdrawn; fresh order under the Supply Code.
headnote: The Allahabad High Court disposed of a writ against a recovery citation for electricity-theft dues on the Electricity Department's statement that the citation dated 16 December 2022 had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after following the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Shivlal Jaiswal challenged a recovery citation dated 16 December 2022 issued by respondent no. 4 for electricity dues in a theft case. The State of U.P. and three others were respondents. At the hearing, counsel for the Electricity Department placed on record a letter of the Executive Engineer dated 23 January 2023 and stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: Withdrawal of theft recovery and fresh order under the Supply Code
holding_units.holding: The petition was disposed of in terms of the Electricity Department's statement that the recovery citation dated 16.12.2022 stood withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after following the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: No clause number is given; the order refers only to the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The writ was disposed on counsel's statement that the 16.12.2022 recovery citation for theft dues was withdrawn and that a fresh order would follow the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, without the Court identifying or construing any clause.

not_decided.point: Whether any electricity-theft dues were recoverable, and in what amount
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the theft allegation or the withdrawn citation on merits. A fresh order under the Supply Code was left to the Department.
